title: Forged in the Dark District / Location (third-party content)
description: Frontmatter contract for a droppable Forged-in-the-Dark district or location. Maps to a Sled Dog World location entry (name/description columns + a rich `details` payload). Write from the Blades in the Dark SRD vocabulary; use no Duskwall setting text, NPCs, art, or maps.

slug.description: kebab-case, no leading 'the-'. Sled Dog namespaces it (e.g. ext:<author>:<slug>).

summary.description: One-line hook shown on the crew's Manage content page.

description.description: The Place — what it is, who runs it, why folk go there (or stay away).

security.description: Relative security/watch presence 0–6 (informs Tier of opposition here).

impressions.description: Sensory beats — what the crew notices on arrival.

features.description: Keyed features / notable sites within the district.

factions.description: Factions with a stake here (name + a line on their interest).

scoreSeeds.description: Trouble the district throws off — seeds for scores set here.

hooks.description: Reasons the district pulls a crew into motion.

images.description: Optional images shipped to the party image gallery when this module is installed (a supporter feature). Files live beside this .md in the content repo; Sled Dog serves them from GitHub raw, pinned to the content commit.

file.description: Path to the image relative to this module folder (e.g. "art/homefront.png"). No leading slash, no "..".

caption.description: Short title shown on the gallery card.

description.description: Longer notes shown when the card is expanded.

url.description: A published Supabase public URL (paid packs). Alternative to `file`.

pack.description: For paid-pack content only: the pack slug this item belongs to.
